text:
maria: quick sync — we're blocked on who should own SA claim routing for quota/telemetry attribution. console team says UI should decide, auth-proxy says routing belongs at the edge.
kevin: we need a single source of truth. if console owns it we get better UX for rollouts, but proxy has live request context.
sasha: leaning proxy. console can set preferred ownership, but runtime should trust proxy-signed claims.
maria: can we make that hybrid? console writes desired owner, proxy signs claim like `owner:console` or `owner:proxy` and we include provenance in telemetry.
leo: hybrid sounds ok, but how do we avoid attribution flip-flops for long-lived keys? sticky ownership matters for billing.
kevin: proposal: default to proxy-derived owner unless console has an explicit `claim_override` flag on the SA. proxy validates override via signed assertion from control plane.
sasha: example config sketch:

```
sa_policies:
  - sa_id: sa-123
    default_owner: proxy
    claim_override: console
    override_signature: "<signed-by-console>"
```

maria: that addresses sticky ownership + console UX. telemetry events should include `owner_source` (proxy/console) and `override_signature_ok` boolean.
leo: add an event `owner_changed` with prev_owner, new_owner, reason for easy regression and billing audits.
kevin: rollout plan: gate behavior behind ff `sa_claim_owner_hybrid`, canary 1% traffic -> 10% -> 50% with sledged sampling of affected SAs.
ops-bot: deploy-bot started canary: sa_claim_owner_hybrid=on for 1% traffic in prod :rocket:
sasha: we also need console surface: show authoritative owner and last_signed_by timestamp in SA details, and a button to re-sign override.
maria: action items: kevin to draft API for override signature, sasha to update proxy validation logic, leo to add telemetry schema, i'll add console UX mock and rollout playbook. tagging @kevin @sasha for owners.
kevin: will add API PR by EOD.
sasha: I'll open proxy PR tomorrow and include unit tests for signature expiry.
leo: I'll add telemetry events to the schema and notify billing for test replays.
maria: thanks all — we'll review in Monday eng-platform sync if there are no blockers.
